policy: Fetch exact pinned revisions by default. Override only for explicit exploratory work; re-freeze before confirmatory runs.

ult.redistribution: Do not mirror benchmark data in GreenUTest; fetch the pinned upstream. Keep reference tests evaluator-side.
ult.plt_role: paired intentionally leaked diagnostic benchmark; keep its tests evaluator-side during generation

bugsinpy.license_note: Use upstream framework/project terms; do not vendor checked-out projects.

swe_mutation.license_note: Re-check third-party task/repository licenses before execution or redistribution.

testgeneval.license_note: Upstream repository states majority code is CC-BY-NC; third-party files may differ. Optional robustness benchmark.
testgeneval.role: core full benchmark for confirmatory RQ2; Lite is pilot/integration only

testexplora.dataset_note: Official repo expects a separate benchmark JSON path and does not vendor the benchmark data at repository root. Keep external and record exact dataset artifact hash.
testexplora.role: core proactive Fail-to-Pass real-fault benchmark; local benchmark JSON must be hashed before freeze

starouter.role: optional upstream provenance; clean-room starouter_style remains default

pynguin.role: traditional non-LLM baseline; pin compatible release for confirmatory runs

testforge.role: fixed execution/coverage-feedback agentic baseline; implement clean-room protocol unless official artifact is pinned

swe_router.role: clean-room temporal value-routing control only; task differs from GreenUTest
